bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 10 日均线，100 日均线在上方

read.en: AMD surged 13.3% on Nov 9 to $508.58, trading $468.21–515.18 on volume 1.8 times its 20-day average. It is above the rising 200-day ($417.22) and the falling 5-day ($466.94) and 10-day ($501.15), but below the falling 100-day ($526.87) and 30-day ($555.98). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($545.69), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: AMD 11月9日大涨 13.3%，收于 $508.58，盘中区间 $468.21–515.18，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.8 倍。股价位于上行的 200 日均线（$417.22）以及下行的 5 日（$466.94）和 10 日均线（$501.15）上方，但仍在下行的 100 日（$526.87）和 30 日均线（$555.98）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$545.69），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The rally cleared the $455, $471 and $503 resistances (5-day, Nov 2–4 lows, Oct 22 low and 10-day), now support. Resistance is $514.6–515.2 (Nov 4 and Nov 9 highs), then $520.4–526.9 (Oct 30 high, 100-day) and $545.7 (SAR). Support is $501–503, then $466–476 and $433–440.5. A close above $515.2 would target $520–527; below $501, $466–476.
